name: @jigging/jig
description: Private prerelease Jig authoring and FLOW package-checking candidate

scripts.build: bun run clean && mkdir -p bin libexec/evaluator && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/internal/linux-rootless-supervisor.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=libexec/linux-rootless-supervisor.js && bun build src/internal/project-evaluator-worker.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=libexec/evaluator/project-evaluator-worker.js && bun build src/project/evaluator-sdk-entry.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=libexec/evaluator/project-evaluator-sdk.bundle.js && cp ../../docs/spec/machine/project-authoring-1.schema.json dist/project-authoring-1.schema.json && cp ../../docs/spec/machine/project-authoring-1.schema.json libexec/evaluator/project-authoring-1.schema.json && bun build src/installed-cli.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64-baseline --outfile=bin/jig
scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; for (const path of ['dist', 'bin', 'libexec']) await rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:linux-rootless:proof-host: bun run build && JIG_LINUX_ROOTLESS_HOSTILE=1 bun test test/linux-rootless-run.test.ts --timeout 30000 && JIG_LINUX_ROOTLESS_HOSTILE=1 bun test test/private-foreground.test.ts --timeout 30000
